convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorBulls indicator and relies on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator buffer color-index reading (0,2 values) requires understanding the ColorBulls implementation.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timestamp

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar close
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar close

other_exits: Buy closes when ColorBulls buffer transitions from color 2 to color 0 (bearish color change)
Sell closes when ColorBulls buffer transitions from color 0 to color 2 (bullish color change)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 with LOT mode means 0.1 lots fixed; with other modes, 0.1 means 10% of the respective margin base.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads ColorBulls indicator buffer 1 (color index buffer) at SignalBar offset. Col[1] is the older bar, Col[0] is the newer bar. Buy signal: Col[1]==0 (was bearish/no color) AND Col[0]==2 (turned bullish). Sell signal: Col[1]==2 (was bullish) AND Col[0]==0 (turned bearish). When SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick rather than only on new bars. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags can independently disable long entry, short entry, long close, and short close. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure bar data availability. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit. The signal time is set to the last bar date plus one period shift, implying trades execute at the next bar open.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorBulls custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python or its logic extracted. It uses two smoothing passes (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) with configurable methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) on an applied price. The color index buffer (0=bearish, 2=bullish) is the key signal source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, and LoadHistory - all must be reimplemented. The MarginMode-based position sizing has 5 modes that need faithful reproduction. Signal bar reading at offset SignalBar (default 1) means the EA trades on the previous completed bar's color transition, not the current forming bar. TimeShiftSec is added to SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE to compute the effective signal time for position open functions.
